"Can we help you, sir? Can we help you?" everyone exclaimed as they arrived.

"No, thank you, I know where to get my item, thank you very much."

"Don't hesitate to ask me if you have any questions, I'll answer them."

"???" Okay, but it sounded a bit too generic, almost condescending.

I realized the item was going to cost an extra $2. She had to read the box three times to figure out what it was because I asked her to check the shelf label.

So it was taking a while, I saw she'd gotten to the dog section.

I scanned it three times, explained it to a colleague, the same scenario played out until a second colleague came back to repeat the whole explanation.

I waited and waited before finally paying and repackaging it myself.

3 stars because Mondou added an extra size of the product that I love. Except that for their assistance ride, 0. Avoid the people on the floor so as not to waste your time.

Today, February 24, 2026, I arrived at the door and found a barricade. There was no message on the door. I called, but there was still no message. Frustrating! In general, the staff isn't very welcoming or helpful. When I have the chance, I try to go to other Mondou stores.

Souhaila the girl who does the nail clippings should seriously consider a new job. Careless handling, unsafe nail trim
I brought my dog in for a nail trim, and she clipped the nails too short, causing him to bleed. It was clear she wasn’t confident, but she didn’t say anything beforehand. While she applied styptic powder to stop the bleeding, the experience was traumatic for my dog and extremely stressful for me. She gave me no instructions going forward for the powder and the bleeding. I would not recommend this person or this  service at this location  as proper skill and caution are crucial during nail trims. I can now see that I am not the only one who has issues with her. ⬇️
Horrible! I went and one of the employees called me "autistic" for "taking too long" Lindsay is her name.

First and last time going to Mondou. I called ahead, was told they could trim my dog’s nails, and drove 40 minutes. When I arrived, the employee named Souhaila tried giving him a treat (he’s a picky eater), and when he didn’t take it, she acted like it was an issue. In the grooming room he simply pulled his paw back once, no aggression, no sound, and the employee refused the service and even suggested he might have a heart problem?? Completely unprofessional and out of line!!!

My dog is healthy, fully vetted, travels regularly, and has never been refused by any groomer.
I went straight to Chico on rue Sauvé afterward and they trimmed his nails with no problem at all.

This experience showed a lack of professionalism and basic knowledge. I won’t be going to any Mondou again.

Last weekend, I walked into the store and a staff member asked if I needed assistance. I politely declined since I knew what I was looking for and also just wanted to browse. Almost immediately after, the same staff member approached me again and asked the same question. I declined again and the staff stayed in the aisle and started "stocking shelves". I felt very uncomfortable as if I was being racially profiled. Her disposition was very unfriendly.

Once I found the product I wanted. It was too high on the shelf for my reach. I asked the staff to kindly get it for me and she seemed irritated. Once she retrieved the item, I held my hands out for her to give it to me and she insisted on bringing it to the cash register as if I was going to run out of the store once I had it. My plan was to continue browsing but felt like I was being rushed out of the store, so I paid for my items and left.

Didn't appreciate my experience at all and don't think I will shop at this location again.

Today in particular, I received exceptional help; just thinking about it makes me like, "Wow!" It really brightened my day. My little Clair-Obscur was treated like a true princess. I must have spent a good hour in the store hesitating over which kitten food to choose because I adopted a little Maine Coon/Siberian mix with special needs, and I found the best for my little princess. A thousand thanks for that. A cute little wool sweater, a harness, and food beyond my expectations. A meal fit for a king for my baby, to the point that Madame Owl had a fit of jealousy 😂😂
